evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Joanna: 'It might take about ten to fifteen minutes so we can give you a personalized estimate.' — Time frame given but no explicit promise of dependable quote framing, and no clear wait for affirmative response before pivoting to agenda check.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Joanna: 'But before we start aside from the pricing, do you have any other important concerns that you also want to discuss on this call?' — Asked before probing, customer answers 'No.'
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Covered: property type (condo), floor/stories (ground floor), rooms (1 bedroom, 11 unit number), walking distance (~100 feet/two school buses), additional items (two couches, pool table, desk, bed frame), special considerations (folded pool table, ground-to-ground treadmill, boxes ~50). No explicit 'number of rooms' in origin property but garage contents well-probed.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Joanna: 'I'll just put you within that range for now... an estimated budget of $480 for a two and a half hour job to $672 for a three and a half hour job.' Personalized to one-bedroom equivalent, travel time, walking distance, and two-mover recommendation ($192/hr for two movers).
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Joanna: '$96 per hour per mover... two minimum... all inclusive rates. I can guarantee that there are no other fees... truck, wrapping, taxes, insurance, credit card fees all in the price... no fuel or transportation fees... two and a half hour minimum... charge in every fifteen minute interval.' Full disclosure of trip/material fees and 2.5-hour minimum + 15-minute increments framing present.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage: Joanna: 'Our no worries damage coverage which would give you up to $2,000 coverage for any repair replacement reimbursement for any accidental damages.' — Mentions $2,000 and coverage but does not explicitly state 'no deductible' or 'no fine print' or confirm it is built into rate (not add-on).
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: Joanna: 'And lastly on time guarantee if we run late we provide discounts for your move.' — Mentions guarantee and discount terms but lacks specificity on when discount starts/percentage.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Joanna: 'So, with that being said would you like our help for this move tomorrow?' — Direct, plain ask with no softened out.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Joanna: 'No deposits. And the payment is only upon completion of the move, okay?' — Rate is locked by quoting; no-deposit commitment is explicit.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial: Availability windows offered (11:00 AM–1:00 PM, 12:30–2:30 PM, two-hour arrival window). Phone follow-up mentioned ('we definitely call you once we're on the way'). Email confirmation to follow. BUT customer did not commit on-call ('Can I give you a callback? I have to consult with my partner'), so date/crew size/addresses were never confirmed for booking. Only availability and payment terms confirmed.

top_strength: Joanna conducted exceptionally thorough logistics probing—she systematically clarified the garage contents, item-by-item weights and dimensions (treadmill, pool table, couches, desk, bed frame), box count, parking logistics at both origin and destination, and walking distance—building a highly detailed and personalized estimate without needing a walkthrough.
coaching_note: Section 2's quid pro quo lacked the explicit 'dependable quote' promise and wasn't followed by a clear pause for affirmation before moving to the agenda check; Section 6 had no final concerns re-check at all; and Section 4's 'Does that feel fair?' was never asked—add these three critical closing-loop moments to ensure nothing is left unaddressed before the ask.
